outline: This course is to instruct students the basic concepts of financial technology and to enable students to develop innovative applications of financial technology. The contents include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, P2P lending, virtual money, third-party payment, crowd funding, P2P remittance, blockchain, etc.
schedule:
1.	Introduction to Fintech
2.	Mobile payment
3.	Crowd funding
4.	P2P remittance
5.	Blockchain
6.     Embedded Finance

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
